evidence: Ticket status now emits agent_owned instead of agent. Installed iPhone builds 9 (0cde68a6) and 10 (staging 770fd5ee4) decode String but WorkerGroups.swift compares literal agent and misclassifies an idle owned Ticket as Empty. Raise MINIMUM_SUPPORTED_BUILD to 11 and set the new app build to 11. Existing HTTP admission refuses builds 9 and 10 with 426 ios_update_required before reads or actions; the existing native latch requests a TestFlight update and retains drafts. New clients accept both status spellings for cached and immutable historical receipt snapshots and coordinated rollout, while current server reads emit agent_owned only. Desktop bridge 1 has the same presentation risk. Raise its published minimum and new shell bridge to 2. Old desktop API reads and actions receive 426 desktop_update_required, except GET/HEAD /api/meta so the native updater can discover the floor. Shared Fastify injection covers old/native floor read/action refusal, supported-client reads, and no refused action execution. Ticket status is derived from worker_step_claim; startup signal attachment rebuilds durable navigation caches, covered by an old-agent cache fixture, so no schema step is required. Signed-device behavior, TestFlight distribution, and signed desktop update installation were not tested on this Linux host. Matching client releases must be available for this server release; production deployment remains a later owner action.
